name: Pattaya
source:
In this game, our protagonist Dude and his friend Jimmy will go together to visit the charming streets of Pattaya, Thailand, where they will pick the most beautiful girls. They visit Thai yoga studios and work out with beautiful women. They will go to a Thai massage shop and enjoy a wonderful massage. They will go to the hotel and meet a beautiful lady. All in all, it is a fantastic story where Dude and Jimmy went on a fantastic adventure together.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2282690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在本作中，主角Dude与朋友Jimmy将结伴游览泰国芭提雅迷人的街道，挑选最漂亮的女孩。他们会到泰式瑜伽馆，与美女一起锻炼；也会去泰式按摩店，享受美妙的按摩；还会走进酒店，邂逅美丽的女士。总而言之，这是Dude与Jimmy共同经历精彩冒险的一段奇妙故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2282690/]Steam[/url]]
